C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT.Name: Compact-window fit and keyboard integrity for Quick Settings, Settings navigation and sheets
C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT.Summary: Make the titlebar Quick Settings panel, the Settings toolbar and the Advanced-tab modal sheets usable at the app's compact window sizes (the editor window's 600x400 minimum through the Settings window's fixed 640x620), give the controls that still lack it the established visible keyboard-focus outline, trap focus inside the modal sheets, and make the titlebar «Aa» button spacebar-operable. The treatments reuse the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS outline canon, the recent/index.vue enter+space pair and the Element Plus focus-trap precedent; no palette, anatomy or interaction redesign is proposed.
C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT.Problem: DESIGN:F-002/F-003 (frontend-design wave 35): in compact windows the Quick Settings popover and the Settings navigation break. Observed in code: the Quick Settings panel (components/titleBar/quickSettings/index.vue) is a 428px absolute panel whose only height bound is the body's max-height: 62vh with overflow hidden on the panel itself — at the editor window's 600x400 minimum (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json minWidth/minHeight) the toolbar, body and footer must all fit under the title bar with no total-height cap, so the footer row clips and the body can double-limit. The Settings toolbar (prefComponents/tabsBar/index.vue) renders seven min-width:76px column tabs on macOS and icon+label underline tabs elsewhere; the Settings window is fixed 640x620 and non-resizable (m_v1_compat.rs mt_open_setting_window), the underline variant has no shrink floor, and localized labels can push tabs past the window edge; the settings-shell e2e overflow walker covers .pref-body * only, never the toolbar. DESIGN:F-005/F-006: several interactive controls carry all: unset (or bare div chrome) with no :focus-visible rule — the settings toolbar .pref-tab buttons, the Quick Settings «Aa» button (.quick-settings-btn), the View tab .theme-family-tile radio tiles, the Page tab .linkish Reset row and the sheet's .pref-sheet-close — so keyboard users get no visible target on them, while the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS outline already covers the shared switch/select/segment controls and the Quick Settings tab/open-all rows. DESIGN:F-007: the modal sheet (prefComponents/common/sheet/index.vue) declares role="dialog" aria-modal="true" but implements only an Escape handler — Tab walks out of the sheet onto the dimmed page beneath, initial focus is not claimed and closing does not restore focus, unlike the Element Plus el-dialog trap the repo already rides in editor.vue (@open-auto-focus precedent). DESIGN:F-010: the «Aa» button binds @keydown.enter.prevent only, so WAI-ARIA button Space activation does nothing on it; the repo already ships the correct enter+space pair on role=button rows in components/recent/index.vue.

Goals.R-1: Bind the Quick Settings panel to its window: at any viewport down to 600x400 the open panel lies fully inside the viewport below the title bar, the three-tab toolbar and the Open Settings footer stay pinned and visible, the tab body is the single scroll region (the components already support a flex column with an overflow-y body), and no control is clipped or unreachable; at the Settings hand-off sizes (640x620) and large windows the approved mock metrics (428px width, radius, shadow, row anatomy) are unchanged.
Goals.R-2: Keep the Settings toolbar inside its fixed 640x620 window in both platform variants (macOS centred column tabs, Windows/Linux underline tabs) and across the shipped locale catalogs: tabs shrink with label ellipsis instead of pushing past the window edge, no horizontal overflow of the toolbar or its tabs, the macOS drag-region strip and every tab's click and keyboard reachability are unchanged, and the body keeps its existing vertical scroll.
Goals.R-3: Give the remaining interactive controls the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS treatment — a 2px solid var(--prefAccent) outline with 1px offset shown only for :focus-visible — at their owning components: the «Aa» button chrome (.quick-settings-btn), the View tab family tiles (.theme-family-tile), the Page tab Reset row (.linkish), the Settings toolbar tabs (.pref-tab) and the sheet Close button (.pref-sheet-close). Selected/on/active state stays visually distinct from keyboard focus; pointer activation stays outline-free.
Goals.R-4: Make the modal sheet modal for keyboards: while a sheet is open, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the sheet's panel, initial focus moves inside the panel when it opens, focus returns to the invoking control when it closes, and the dimmed page beneath never receives keyboard focus. Escape-close, the Close button, the three Advanced sheets' content flows and the sheet's 560px mock metrics are unchanged. Prefer the Element Plus focus-trap pattern already in the repo (the deep per-component import convention, as el-dialog rides @open-auto-focus today); if the pinned element-plus build does not expose it, implement the same semantics in the sheet's existing capture-phase keydown handler — either way no new dependency.
Goals.R-5: Make the «Aa» button spacebar-operable per WAI-ARIA button semantics: Space activates it exactly like Enter (the components/recent/index.vue enter+space pair precedent) with the default action prevented, and the Enter path is unchanged.

Constraints.Constraint: Stay inside the approved anatomy: the Quick Settings palette, 428px panel width, row anatomy and C-38 metrics, the Settings shell metrics and the sheet's 560px panel are verbatim from the approved mocks; the compact-fit work adds only height binding, shrink/ellipsis behavior, focus outlines, trap wiring and the Space binding. If a required surface cannot reach the goal within this scope, stop for a bounded scope revision.

No window-size changes: the editor window stays minWidth 600 / minHeight 400 (tauri.conf.json) and the Settings window stays fixed non-resizable 640x620 (m_v1_compat.rs mt_open_setting_window). No new dependencies, IPC, preference keys, tab-order overhaul, global focus reset or parallel visual system; the trap may reuse the element-plus focus-trap component under the existing deep per-component import convention or a hand-rolled cycle in the sheet's existing handler.

Keyboard-focus presentation follows the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS canon: :focus-visible only, no JavaScript focus manager, no tabindex changes beyond what the sheet trap legitimately needs, existing switch/select/segment outlines and their verification keep passing unchanged.

Keep all existing failures, retries, skips, timeouts and coverage floors. The existing gates keep passing: quick-settings.test.js shell semantics (open/close, outside click, Escape, bus entry), page-width-panel.spec.ts, settings-shell.spec.ts keyboard-focus and overflow probes, and the width pipeline tests. Focus evidence must use real keyboard input (the checkKeyboardFocus harness), identifying any WebKit Option-Tab fallback; a synthetic focus() call alone is insufficient.

Update the GRACE semantic markup of every touched component (MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, CHANGE_SUMMARY, paired unique START_BLOCK_/END_BLOCK_ where new blocks are introduced) and add the execution-time SummaryDelta for M-011 and M-061 plus the verification refs; do not mutate applied bundles, frozen docs or current graph/verification while this spec is draft. No implementation or plan until the proposed design/spec is explicitly approved.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No full responsive redesign of Settings or the editor window, no per-document theme/CSS work (wave 11 owns those items), no changes to the searchPanel (already fits), the whats-new sheet, the workspace-mode dialog, the unsaved-close dialog or other el-dialog surfaces beyond the shared pref sheet, no tab-order or radio-navigation redesign, no i18n changes beyond any new string the fix genuinely needs, and no release authorization or owner/platform acceptance verdict.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Compact-fit pins for Quick Settings (page-width-panel canon, Chromium): in a 600x400 viewport the open panel on each of the three tabs lies fully inside the viewport (a geometry walker with the existing overflow tolerances proves every descendant rect is inside the window rect), the toolbar and footer are visible and pinned, the body scrolls when its content exceeds the remaining height and every row and control becomes reachable by that scroll alone; at 640x620 and 1440x900 the panel's approved metrics and current open/close semantics are unchanged.

Compact-fit pins for Settings navigation (settings-shell canon, both platform style variants): at 640x620 every .pref-tab rect stays inside the viewport and the toolbar reports no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth at most innerWidth, extending the existing walker to the toolbar), including a stress run with a longest-label shipped locale catalog seeded through the prefs shim; the macOS drag-region attribute and tab routing are unchanged.

Visible keyboard focus: real Tab navigation reaches the «Aa» button, a View tab family tile, the Page tab Reset row, a Settings toolbar tab and an open sheet's Close button, and each shows the 2px accent outline with 1px offset in Paper and Ink while values, geometry, selection and preference-write counts stay invariant (the checkKeyboardFocus harness); Tab-away removes the outline and mouse-only activation does not force it.

Sheet focus integrity (unit and e2e): opening any of the three Advanced sheets moves focus inside the panel; Tab at the last focusable wraps to the first and Shift+Tab at the first wraps to the last; no keystroke moves focus to the page behind while open; closing via Escape or the Close button restores focus to the invoking control; sheet content flows and Esc-close semantics are unchanged.

Unit pins: the «Aa» button activates on Space keydown with the default prevented, producing exactly the Enter path's effect in the existing quick-settings.test.js harness, and the Enter path is unchanged; the sheet trap wiring (initial focus, wrap both directions, restore on close) is pinned in a component test following the tests/renderer/pages/common canon.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Compact-geometry walker output at 600x400, 640x620 and a large viewport; settings-toolbar overflow walker output for both style variants including the locale stress run; real-keyboard focus routes with before/after captures and invariant state files per the checkKeyboardFocus canon; sheet trap wrap/restore transcripts; the unchanged existing gates green. Exact commands and assertion files belong in the later approved execution plan.

Assumptions.Assumption: The compact window range is the editor window's minimum 600x400 (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json main window) through the Settings window's fixed 640x620 (m_v1_compat.rs mt_open_setting_window); the Quick Settings panel lives only in the editor window and the Settings navigation only in the Settings window.

The finding-id to surface mapping follows the brief's listing order (F-002 Quick Settings fit, F-003 Settings navigation fit, F-005/F-006 visible focus, F-007 sheet trap, F-010 Aa Space); the execution plan may re-verify against the wave-35 findings report.

Element Plus 2.14.8 (package.json) ships the focus-trap component used internally by el-dialog; its deep import path must be verified against the pinned build at plan time, with the hand-rolled capture-phase cycle in the sheet as the same-semantics fallback. Either choice satisfies R-4 without a new dependency.
The C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS outline (2px var(--prefAccent), 1px offset) is the design authority for the new focus outlines, exactly as its spec adopted the Quick Settings tab/open-all pattern.
